description: This file contains utility functions and classes for managing SQLite database connections within the notes backend. It includes configuration resolution, database connection parsing, and connection establishment with specific pragmas for consistency.

classes.name: SqliteConfig
classes.description: Immutable dataclass holding the resolved path to the SQLite database file.

methods.name: Optional[Path] _parse_db_connection_txt(connection_txt_path: Path)
methods.description: Parses the db_connection.txt file to extract the database file path if specified.

methods.name: SqliteConfig resolve_sqlite_config()
methods.description: Determines the SQLite database configuration by checking the environment variable, the connection text file, or defaulting to a local file.

methods.name: sqlite3.Connection connect_sqlite(*, config: SqliteConfig)
methods.description: Establishes a SQLite connection with specific pragmas for consistent behavior.
